What the checks found

  • Correct source speaker, pose tokens, and 2-second prefill boundary.
  • The source already contains unreliable hand detections: all decoded prefill hand confidences are below 0.3, and about 95% lie outside the image.
  • The existing dashboard renders normalized x/W and y/H at equal scale, squeezing this portrait pose vertically. It also draws every low-confidence joint and includes outliers when choosing its view bounds.

The matching video was recovered from HF bucket InternalCan/aloe-face-clips-hires-v1. Its SHA256 matches the source manifest. Original extracted poses and exact timing were recovered from InternalCan/aloe-conversationa-data.
